A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the VAGUE benchmark and Multimodal Intention Disambiguation task. Their complete main texts, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support comparison despite added sections and renumbering.

before.justification: v2 reports original model evaluations, a 400-item human evaluation, failure-mode analyses, OCR checks, and chain-of-thought experiments, including appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains original empirical results and adds evaluations of larger models, caption-source comparisons, and open-source chain-of-thought experiments.

M1.justification: The MID formulation, GPT-4o expression-generation pipeline, human filtering, and FS/SU/NE distractor construction remain unchanged. The caption-source and chain-of-thought additions extend evaluation rather than introduce a new proposed method.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same 1,144 VCR and 533 Ego4D instances for multiple-choice and free-form intention disambiguation, plus three COCO images for OCR checks. No dataset, domain, or task coverage is added or removed.

E2.justification: v3 adds InternVL-3 (38B) and Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct (72B) to benchmark, human-reference, free-form, and OCR comparisons. It also adds six open-source models to the previously proprietary-only CoT comparison, substantially broadening comparator participation in that experiment.

E3.justification: Table F3 introduces a controlled SM setting that replaces self-generated captions with GPT-4o captions, and evaluation configurations extend to 38B and 72B models. Existing dataset sizes, the 400-item human subset, metrics, refusal-scoring rule, and prompt templates remain unchanged.

E4.justification: New Appendix F tests whether caption source explains SM performance differences. New Appendix G examines CoT sensitivity across six open-source models, finding VLM accuracy declines unlike the retained proprietary-model results. These substantially extend the diagnostic evidence beyond v2.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or comparable uncertainty estimates. Both use point accuracies, similarity scores, and error counts without introducing a new statistical reporting practice.

E6.justification: New results include Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct (72B) VLM accuracies of 74.2% on VCR and 69.8% on Ego4D, plus caption-source and open-source CoT outcomes. In Table 2, the strongest reported model changes from InternVL-2.5-MPO (26B), at 63.0%, to Qwen at 72.3%. Shared non-CoT scores remain unchanged. Tables J5/J6 remove the proprietary CoT multiple-choice and free-form rows previously in H3/H4, while aggregate Table 3 is retained.

T1.justification: Equation 1, the scene-confined reasoning assumptions, and the directness/indirectness criteria are retained. No mathematical definition, proof, theorem, or substantive derivation is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same benchmark contribution and claims about visual-context benefits, the human–model gap, and superficial interpretation failures. Updated model results refine the gap reported in Section 5.3 without redefining these core claims.

C2.justification: Appendices F–G add mechanism hypotheses involving caption quality, text-versus-image token handling, and conditioning dilution during longer CoT generation. Existing cultural, linguistic, annotation-quality, and free-form metric limitations remain substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: The abstract changes the code/data access instruction from a direct GitHub repository link to the project website. Existing generation prompts, evaluation templates, human-rating instructions, and dataset schema are retained; no new hardware or hyperparameter documentation is supplied.

R1.justification: v3 adds citations for InternVL3, visual-information grounding for hallucination control, and visual-token/parameter efficiency. The latter two support the new appendix interpretations. The main related-work positioning remains largely unchanged.

P1.justification: There are localized wording reductions and corrections, author-affiliation and footnote edits, and new Appendix F/G sections that shift former F–H to H–J. Most prose and the main narrative structure remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 4 expands from ten to twelve model panels; existing comparison tables gain rows; Tables F3 and G4 are added. The full-results tables change row membership and clarify the correct-count header. Tables and appendix material reflow, while the overall format and existing example/prompt illustrations are preserved.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a more balanced empirical assessment: v2's proprietary-only CoT gains are complemented by open-source VLM declines, stronger baselines, and a caption-source control. These gains are tempered by removal of detailed proprietary CoT results and new reporting inconsistencies, including differing InternVL-3 accuracies between Table 1 and Tables J5/J6 and exceptions to Appendix G's claim that every error type increases.
